verdict: Maybe, for a healthcare operator. The Renal Project pitched home dialysis on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Dialysis patients face exhausting hospital visits several times a week, and home care improves their lives, but it needs trained staff, strict protocols and medical oversight.
angle: Chronic kidney disease patients need regular dialysis, and centres are crowded. Home dialysis requires trained technicians, sterile equipment and nephrologist supervision. Partnerships with hospitals and insurers help with referrals and payments.
